description: This file defines an interface INamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory in the Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions namespace. The interface provides a method for creating instances of ITransactionalStateStorage by name, parameterized by a generic state type.
external_methods: Create<TState>(string storageName, string stateName) where TState : class, new()

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ITransactionalStateStorage for the specified state type, given the storage and state names. Returns null if not found.
